record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace the training-frequency input scale 1 + 0.02*tanh(z) with 1 + 0.02*z/sqrt(1+z*z), where z remains standardized log1p training item counts. This more gradually saturating feature may reduce sensitivity to moderately frequent items while retaining bounded frequency information. Keep padding and mask scales at 1; preserve embeddings, backbone, readout, loss and optimizer. Save the scales in each category’s single checkpoint.
